## 分诊 · `domain:ui` / `priority:p2` / `pm:queue`

**Anchor read, not guessed** —— 车道跟随推荐处置。选项 **(a)**(渲染器改读已声明的键)落在 `packages/components/src/renderers/overlay/alert-dialog.tsx` ⇒ **`domain:ui`**,文档重写随之。⚠️ 若裁为 **(b)**(声明渲染器实际读的键),落点变成 `packages/types` ⇒ **交接 `domain:spec`** —— 那是一次交接,不是一次改判。

复核 objectui `origin/main` `a472b07`(2026-09-05T00:55:13Z),三个面互不相交,一字不差:

```
types/src/overlay.ts:110   cancelLabel?: string;
types/src/overlay.ts:115   confirmLabel?: string;
types/src/overlay.ts:120   confirmVariant?: 'default' | 'destructive';

components/…/alert-dialog.tsx:35   {renderChildren(schema.content)}
components/…/alert-dialog.tsx:37   {schema.cancelText && <AlertDialogCancel>{schema.cancelText}</AlertDialogCancel>}
components/…/alert-dialog.tsx:38   {schema.actionText && <AlertDialogAction onClick={schema.onAction}>{schema.actionText}</AlertDialogAction>}
```

### ⭐ 本席补一个卡面提到但没有精确引用的**第四个面**

```
components/…/alert-dialog.tsx:49   { name: 'cancelText',  type: 'string', label: 'Cancel Text',  defaultValue: 'Cancel' },
components/…/alert-dialog.tsx:50   { name: 'actionText',  type: 'string', label: 'Action Text', defaultValue: 'Continue' },
components/…/alert-dialog.tsx:67   cancelText: 'Cancel',
```

⇒ **注册 `inputs`(设计器/调色板面)与 `defaultProps` 都说未声明方言。** 卡面只提了 `defaultProps`。这很要紧,因为 `inputs` 会被序列化进 `sdui.manifest.json` 与 `sdui-intrinsics.d.ts`(本仓 #6955 刚刚记录过这条链)—— ⇒ **JSX 授权面也在教这套未声明的拼写**。⛔ 任何处置都必须同时移动 `inputs`,否则会留下第四份方言。

### 定级 p2

⭐ 咬到作者的方向非常明确,卡面写得最好:

> **严格照着已发布类型书写的文档,渲染出一个空页脚。** 渲染器只在 `schema.cancelText` 为真时画 `AlertDialogCancel`,只在 `schema.actionText` 为真时画 `AlertDialogAction`。
>
> 而**真正能用的那套键**(`cancelText` / `actionText` / `onAction` / `content`)之所以被接受,**只是因为 `BaseSchema` 带了 `[key: string]: any`** —— 没有编辑器会提示它们,也没有任何一页写出它们。

⇒ **编辑器补全出来的是不工作的那套;工作的那套没人告诉你。** 不是 p3(用户可见的失败:按钮不出现)。不是 p1(不是数据错误,作者看到空页脚会立刻发现有问题)。

### ⭐ 为什么没有任何红色覆盖它 —— 四条,全部成立,值得原样保留

卡面把「为什么这能活下来」查得很干净:

1. `zod-mirror-parity.test.ts` 比的是 TS 声明与它的 zod 镜像 —— **这两者是一致的**(都带 `cancelLabel`/`confirmLabel`/`onConfirm`),**渲染器不是那场比较的当事人**。
2. `check:doc-snippets` 只编译 `ts`/`tsx`/`typescript` 围栏;`actions` 那一行在 `plaintext` 围栏里,⇒ 没有 gate 解析它(#5250 / #5867)。
3. `check:doc-types` 只从文档代码块里读 `type` 字符串字面量。
4. **#6150 的普查声明了 13 个「渲染器读、类型没有」的键,但 `alert-dialog` 不在它的账本里**(`undeclared-but-consumed-keys-6150.test.ts`)。

⇒ ⭐ 四道仪器,四个不同的构造性盲区,**这个组件恰好落在它们全部的缝里** —— 这是 #4631 命名的那个一般类的一个具体实例,而它是本席今晚见到的最完整的一个标本。

### 边界测试 —— 三条处置都跨地板,方向不同

- **(a)** 渲染器改读已声明键、退役未声明方言 ⇒ **改变已发布组件的运行时行为**:任何用「能用方言」写的存量文档会**停止工作**。⇒ 人工地板之上。
- **(b)** 声明渲染器实际读的键、按 ADR-0049 退役惰性声明键 ⇒ **从已发布类型移除成员** ⇒ 人工地板之上。
- **(c)** 拆分:保留 `content`(兄弟 overlay 类型都声明的真实 body 槽),按钮对单独裁。

⇒ ⛔ 本席不裁。⭐ 卡面对 (a) 的论证是这三条里最强的,原样保留:**契约优先 —— 已发布类型胜出;而且已声明的名字本身更好,`confirmVariant` 更是 `actionText` 方言根本表达不了的能力。** ⚠️ 但它自己也点明了代价:**它改变已发布运行时行为**,所以需要一次分诊裁决而不是顺手改。

⚠️ 本席补一条对 (a) 的现实约束:`defaultProps` 与 `inputs` 今天都发 `cancelText`/`actionText`,**所以「能用方言」不只是作者自己摸索出来的 —— 是组件自己教的**。⇒ (a) 的存量影响面比「有人碰巧这么写」要大,迁移说明是交付的一部分,不是附注。

### ⛔ 无论哪条,文档欠的不止两行

> `alert-dialog.mdx` **欠一次整个 Schema 块的重写,而不只是 #7082 动的那两行。**

⇒ ⭐ 而且那一页还发布了**第三种拼写**(`actions?: ComponentSchema[]`)—— **TS 接口没有、镜像没有、渲染器里 `schema.actions` 一次都不出现**。无论裁哪条,那一行都是幽灵,应当删除。

⛔ 范围围栏采纳:#7082 被围在文档行上,只改类型名;本卡是声明/渲染器分歧,**立卡而不是折进去是对的**。

⛔ 本席不认领、不派发、不代裁。

## ⛔ Correction #3 — the index signature defeats BOTH loud channels, so on this repo's component schemas removal is **fully silent**

Third revision of this discriminator by the seat that wrote it. Measured on card #7104 (PR #7700) by an `os-dev` seat at `claude-fable-5-1`, and re-verified directly by me on `origin/main` `6e8863093` before posting.

### What each revision said

| version | claim about deleting an optional member from a surviving carrier |
| :-- | :-- |
| original | "can arrive through a widened value and nothing complains" — **silent** |
| correction #1 (comment 5548864634) | silent **only** when the value shares a key with the carrier; a lone-key widened value trips **TS2559**, a fresh literal **TS2353** |
| **this correction** | correction #1 holds **only on a carrier with no index signature**. `BaseSchema` carries `[key: string]: any`, so on every schema extending it deletion is **silent in all three shapes** |

### The measurement

A 4-carrier × 3-shape probe (fresh literal / lone-key widened value / overlapping-key widened value), run on a LIVE tree and a tree with the members deleted:

| carrier | fresh literal | lone-key widened | overlapping-key widened |
| :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- |
| C1 all-optional, **no** index signature | TS2353 | TS2559 | silent |
| C2 all-optional **with** `[key: string]: any` | silent | silent | silent |
| C4 the real `AlertDialogSchema` | silent | TS2741 (constant — fires identically on the live tree) | silent |

C1 reproduces correction #1 exactly, which is what makes C2 a reading rather than a broken instrument: the two differ only by the index signature, and it is the index signature that removes **both** excess-property checking and the weak-type check.

**Verified by me, independently of that probe**, on `origin/main` `6e8863093`: `packages/types/src/base.ts:440` declares `[key: string]: any`, and `packages/types/src/overlay.ts:83` reads `export interface AlertDialogSchema extends BaseSchema`.

### Why this matters far beyond one card

**Essentially every component schema in this repo extends `BaseSchema`.** So for the carrier branch of this discriminator — the branch that covers every retirement of an optional member from a component schema — the motivating premise is not "usually silent" but **silent, in every value shape**. That is the strongest possible case for a tombstone, and it is stronger than either earlier version of this rule said.

The one channel deletion makes quieter, measured on the same probe: a **wrong-typed** value. `cancelLabel: 123` and `confirmVariant: 'ghost'` read TS2322 while declared and go silent once deleted. So the tombstone's value on these carriers is keeping the *type* error loud, not the *presence* error — the presence error does not exist here at all.

### Corrected wording for the carrier branch

> A `?: never` tombstone is available only on a **surviving carrier**. On a carrier extending `BaseSchema` — which is every component schema in this package — deleting an optional member is **silent in every value shape**, because the `[key: string]: any` index signature removes both excess-property checking and the weak-type check; the only channel the tombstone keeps loud is a wrong-typed value. Tombstone when either prong holds. A whole exported type name has no carrier; there the type-level tombstone (`export type X = never`) trades channels with removal rather than dominating it, and this package has no alias-tombstone convention — remove outright.

⛔ Do not inscribe correction #1's TS2559 sentence into `complex.ts:967` or `mobile.ts:129`. It is true of a bare interface and false of this repo's schemas, which is the only population those comments are read in.

### Standing lesson, recorded because it is now three-for-three

Every version of this rule that I wrote from reasoning rather than from a probe has been wrong, and each was corrected by someone who ran the compiler. The prongs were argued; the carrier precondition was argued; the silence claim was argued twice. **The parts that survived are the parts that were measured.** A discriminator about compiler behaviour belongs to whoever runs the compiler.
